She gave a small bow towards Meorys. "I will remember this. Thank you, Meorys." She then looked back at Sera. "So, after we got out, the Artificer and Midask and I tried to return to the docks. Just before we left, we saw some Redcoats chasing a dinosaur. Well, I got spotted, and the Artificer actually made friends with the dino! Then we road back in it's mouth."
to Meorys, ||That is a relief. I was worried, normally more people are around even at this late hour.||
to Secel, ||...was this dinosaur by any chance,|| she gives a description of Grimlock.
"Dinosaur? Large, likes being pet behind the ears?"
"Indeed. I assume I've somehow missed this?"
she nods to Sabrine, "probably just resting after the fight. don't be too worried about them."
"And-- dinosaur?"
she nods back to Meorys, responding to Secel, ||Roy and I encountered this dinosaur when waiting for a ferry. A fascinating creature, and so friendly.||
"Yeah, earlier today it was taking a nap at the port in Ferrytown."
"I thought it was normal in these parts?"
"Well, the hatred of the Reds is as strong in the dinosaur as it is in the Artificer. I think that's the main reason we weren't eaten."
"Grimlock!!! My mama used to tell me stories about her."
to Seraxa, ||That's her name? It suits her.||
Meorys turns to Sera, "One day, you'll have to take me to meet her, yeah?"
She gives another pat to Orphy
"Back in the days of the uh... Rowing Oak colony. They had this dinosaur named Grimlock who ran around town. Also, I don't know where she is so how can I take you to her? What a weird request."
"And if you mean my mama, she's kinda dead. It's been *years* andyearsandyearsandyears."
"You'll have to tell me that story of Grimlock sometime. As for your mother, I am sorry for your loss." She lowered her head slightly as she spoke those last few words.
"Ehhhh. She deserved it."
"That's... an odd thing to say, I suppose."
Seraxa shrugs. "Just the truth. She was an old hag who made some enemies."
Her eyes widened, the golden yellow becoming more obvious now that her eyes weren't as heavy now. "People actually have a hatred of their parents that they aren't saddened by their passing?"
"There's been a misunderstanding. My mama isn't one of my parents. She's my mama..... I can see why this is confusing."

"I'm not sure if I understand, but if you say so, I'll accept that. Can't say it's any different when I'm telling people about my swarm. Well, used to tell, I suppose. Not many people around since the curfew came into effect."
"Swarm. Swarm. Swarm. Swarm. What a funny word."
(deja vu I've just been in this pub before)
"This curfew kinda sucks. What if I'm just a night worm, you know?"
Sabrine nods in agreement.

"Same here. My people just are up from dusk to noon. Earlier I'd manage to at least find some night shift work to do around here before heading out to hit the city, but now? Three days since curfew and I couldn't find a soul in need of a mechanic at the port"

She blinked several times, then nodded as  if she understood. She mentally noted to maybe ask about just what Sera meant. She then tried to force down a yawn, but the exhaustion was taking hold. "I wish I could continue, but today has worn me out." She gave a final bow, and then added; "If you need anything from me, I will be in my airship, *The Strix*."
"Good, uh..." Roy takes a look at the sky. "night. Good night."
||Good night. It was a pleasure to meet you.||

The Tiefling gave a small giggle. “If we talk again, I’ll have to share the story of when my father managed to get thrown so far off his sleep schedule he actually said “Good morning.” in the middle of the night.” She then turned to Sabrine. “It was a pleasure to meet you, Sabrine.” Then, to everyone, “Take care, and try to not get into too much trouble.” She then made her way back to her ship, almost collapsing on three occasions.
